task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "Through a tennis ball into the blue bin.". Throw a tennis ball into the blue bin. The tennis balls are on the ball rack table (there are 3). Pick one, go to the throw line, and throw it into the bin. The air slows the ball by an unknown amount, so plain projectile math may miss: learn from each throw.
lesson: Compensate for unknown air drag by tracking k equals actual distance divided by predicted distance and aiming the physics model at target distance divided by k
